messages:
Maya (CS): drafting a one-page "mini-runbook" for customer prelaunch checks (prefill, batching, streaming). Want to keep it copy-paste friendly for customers. feedback?
Ike (SRE): short + example-first is ideal. add a tiny troubleshooting triage: prefill not used -> TTL vs prompt mismatch.
Maya (CS): agreed. proposed defaults: small: prefill=100 tokens, batch=8; medium: prefill=500, batch=16; large: prefill=1500, batch=24. Call out cost tradeoffs.
Nina (Solutions): add a 14-day renewal probe for high-risk accounts: daily prefill/checks first 7 days, every other day next 7. capture metrics: prefix_cache_hit_rate, stream_error_rate, p95 latency, token_delta.
Marco (CS Ops): include checklist to paste in support tickets: 1) prefill applied 2) warm pool requested 3) batching params set 4) streaming fallback enabled 5) telemetry hooks installed 6) budget cap tag.
Maya (CS): sample API snippet for customers:
```
POST /v1/prefill
{"tenant_id":"aurora-apps","prefill_tokens":500,"ttl_seconds":7200}
```
Ike (SRE): add config note: for batch_size > 16 enable adaptive_jitter and burst_smoothing on older instance types.
Nina (Solutions): small YAML to share:
```
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 16
  adaptive: true
  jitter_ms: 30-200
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix_cache_ttl: 3600
streaming:
  fallback_to_sync: true
  max_chunk_delay_ms: 80
```
Maya (CS): will produce a one-pager and a paste-in checklist. also a short 'what to watch for' triage: prefix_cache_hit_rate <60% -> increase TTL or reduce prompt variance; stream_error_rate >0.5% -> enable fallback and retries; p95>2s -> reduce batch size or add warm pool.
redwood-schedule-bot: reminder: infra maintenance 2024-11-15 04:00 UTC may slow warm-pool spin-ups.
Maya (CS): noted, will warn customers to avoid bulk provisioning during that window. will push draft to onboarding repo and tag @Nina for final review.
Nina (Solutions): will review tonight. :thumbsup:
